data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

ui_devex.name: openscreen
ui_devex.summary: OpenScreen 是一款开源屏幕录制工具，专为开发者设计，用于制作精美的软件演示视频，无需订阅费或水印。它基于 Electron 和 PixiJS 构建，在录制时实时添加光标高亮和平滑过渡等视觉效果，提升演示的专业度。用户可轻松录制屏幕、应用增强效果，并导出高质量视频，适用于教程制作、产品展示或文档补充，既支持个人项目，也适合商业用途，让技术分享更生动直观。
ui_devex.summary_en: OpenScreen is an open-source screen recording tool that helps developers create polished software demos without subscription fees or watermarks. Built with Electron and PixiJS, it offers real-time visual effects like cursor highlighting and smooth transitions during recording. Users can capture their screen, apply enhancements, and export professional-quality videos for tutorials, product showcases, or documentation, making it ideal for both personal projects and commercial use.

ui_devex.name: oh-my-codex
ui_devex.summary: Oh My Codex 是一个基于 TypeScript 的框架，旨在提升 AI 代码生成的交互性与协作性。它通过模块化的钩子和智能体团队机制，让开发者能够灵活定制 AI 模型处理代码的方式，支持实时反馈和多智能体协同工作流。该框架的核心在于将代码生成过程分解为可组合的步骤，便于调试和优化。你可以将其集成到现有开发工具中，构建更智能的编程助手，尝试不同的智能体配置来解决复杂编码问题，或扩展自定义功能以适应特定项目需求。
ui_devex.summary_en: Oh My Codex is a TypeScript framework that enhances AI code generation by making it more interactive and collaborative. It introduces modular hooks and agent teams that allow developers to customize how AI models process and generate code, enabling real-time feedback and multi-agent workflows. You can integrate it into existing development environments to create smarter coding assistants, experiment with different agent configurations, or build custom extensions for specific programming tasks.
